q: One security control used for physical and environmental security controls is
o: secure disposal of equipment by destroying any storage media.
any equipment should be repaired only by personnel of the company.
use of interactive password management system.
securing mobile equipment against theft when used outside company.
e: Proteger equipamentos móveis contra roubo fora da empresa é controle de segurança física e ambiental.
x: Errada: o controle exige descarte seguro, não destruir qualquer mídia.
Errada: é controle de acesso lógico.
rc: PREFEITURA DE TERESINA PI Analista Tecnológico Analista de Sistemas

q: The reason why you must have an information security police in your organization is to
o: ensure that everyone knows who is responsible for backup procedures.
ensure that staff do not break any laws of the organization.
define who is responsible to provide any resources for security implementation.
give direction to set up information security in the organization.
give overall responsibility to the steering committee.
e: A política de segurança dá direção e apoio para a segurança da informação na organização.
x: Errada: a política não trata disso.
Errada: não é o objetivo principal.
rc: PREFEITURA DE TERESINA PI Analista Tecnológico Analista de Sistemas

q: Consider the figure below showing a hypothetical situation. A criminal holds an hostage and against that, a cop (policeman) also holds an hostage who is a friend of the criminal. In this case, criminal is not going to let the hostage go if cop won't let his friend to let go. Also the cop is not going to let the friend of criminal let go, unless the criminal releases the hostage. Analysing the situation from an Operational System´s point of view, a correct conclusion is
o: a starvation occurs when multiple processes try to access the same resource at the same time.
when two threads need two different resources and each of them has the lock of the resource that the other need, it is a deadlock.
a lock occurs when one thread is still holding on to another resource that the second thread wants after it finishes.
a starvation occurs when the waiting process is no more holding on to another resource that the first needs before it can finish.
a deadlock can only occur in systems with a single processor.
e: Cada lado segura o que o outro precisa e não libera: é um impasse (deadlock).
x: Errada: starvation é espera indefinida, não acesso simultâneo.
Errada: deadlock ocorre também com vários processadores.
rc: TRE-PR Analista Judiciário - Análise de Sistemas
